_comment: Independent B71 C-first offer recipe. A lawful male human Priest creates a lawful altar at the starting square with the source-supported #wizwish terrain syntax, then wishes a matching white unicorn corpse and offers it. This date avoids the new-moon startup pager observed in another retained setup miss. The single space after the corpse wish clears any C --More-- window before #offer; two final spaces cover the insult/deity messages. pray.c:eval_offering returns -1 when unicorn and altar align, so the offer should call offer_negative_valued and gods_upset.
